description: The share of job ads in Finland that state pay, by month, sector and region, with the shares before and after 1 January 2027, when the amended Equality Act is targeted to apply (the law requires pay information before the interview, not in the ad). Aggregate figures only on this connector; per-employer rows need a JobCrawls account. The figures are free to reuse with a visible link to jobcrawls.com. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

includeEmployers.description: Add the employers with the most ads (counts one payTransparencyExport). Signed-in users only; ignored on the public connector.
